description: Locks a named path, examines it and unlocks it again, returning zero when the examined size and date fields match the stored record for the entry and minus one otherwise. The referenced text is a path on a darkseed volume.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:6:092C

description: Reads a hardware position word, adds its two bytes and returns the sum masked to six bits.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:6:0940

description: Calls a routine for a count, then walks a block of strings that each end with a 255 byte, skipping that many strings.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:3:0000

description: Scans up to fifteen pointer-table entries for one whose byte at offset 55 equals the input. It returns zero when found, the input when an empty slot is reached, and minus one when nothing matches, and minus two for non-positive inputs.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:3:0040
name: scan_entry_table_for_id
description: Scans the same fifteen-entry pointer table for an id byte at offset 55 and returns without a result. Non-positive inputs do nothing.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:3:0072
name: compact_and_sort_entry_table
description: Compacts the pointer table so non-empty entries come first, then sorts them in descending order of the byte at offset 6 of each entry.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:3:009C
name: sort_entry_table_descending
description: Sorts the pointer table in descending order of the byte at offset 6 of each entry, without compacting it first.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:3:00CE
name: allocate_and_init_entry_record
description: Allocates an entry record and fills its size, flag and counter fields from the inputs, building a table of strips by calling routines when a flag bit is set. It returns minus three when the allocation fails.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:3:0242
name: allocate_indexed_tile_buffer
description: Allocates a buffer for a slot index up to 49 and stores its pointer and size fields. A flagged request copies rows into a fresh block through a bitwise merge and releases the old block, and allocation failure returns minus three.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:3:0314
name: blit_masked_rows_from_list
description: Owns the blitter, sets the first-word mask from the low bits of the input, then blits rows from a linked list of addresses, choosing between two blit control settings until the list ends. It releases the blitter afterwards.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:3:03AC
name: run_with_temporary_field_value
description: Saves a record field and a flag byte, sets them to new values, sets a word to 1930, calls a routine, resets the word to 1994, then restores the saved field and flag.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:3:04BC
name: collect_marked_record_indices
description: Walks a table of three-byte records until a sentinel, writing the index of each record marked with a second sentinel into a list and counting them in a global.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:3:04FC
name: blit_tile_grid_cells
description: Owns the blitter and copies a grid of tile cells in turn, computing each source offset from the cell index with a 13-column layout and starting one blit per cell. It releases the blitter at the end.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:3:0620
name: update_entries_and_dma_state
description: Writes a DMA control word with the set bit, updates each active entry's position from its stored coordinates and the current phase, and calls routines for entries with pending work. It then writes the control word back without the set bit.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:3:0838
name: build_bit_mask_scaled_size
description: Clears a block of words, then steps an accumulator by a scaled size with a carry each time it passes 999, setting mask bits per row and column. It stores the resulting size fields and fills mask bits from the source rows when they are nonzero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:3:084C
name: build_bit_mask_scaled_size
description: Clears a block of words, then steps an accumulator by a scaled size with a carry each time it passes 999, setting mask bits per row and column. It stores the resulting size fields and fills mask bits from the source rows when they are nonzero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:3:0860
name: build_bit_mask_enable_dma
description: Builds a bit mask from scaled sizes like its neighbours, then runs a larger row-transfer loop. It writes the DMA control register with the channel-enable bit set.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:3:0A36
name: copy_rows_backward_with_mask
description: Copies rows of bytes from a source table into destination rows in reverse order, using step values derived from a constant. It then writes the DMA control word with the set bit and calls two routines.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:3:0CDA
name: blit_table_words_until_done
description: Owns the blitter, sets a destination-only control word, then writes table entries to the destination pointer and size registers row by row until a flag ends it. It releases the blitter afterwards.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:3:0D2C
name: blit_clipped_sprite_rows
description: Owns the blitter and blits sprite rows, clipping the left and right edges against screen columns 48 to 274 and choosing a mask setting from the blit state. It releases the blitter when done.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:3:0E44
name: blit_masked_rows_with_alignment
description: Computes first- and last-word blit masks and modulo values from an x-offset in the input, then owns the blitter and copies rows of a given height using two address tables.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:3:0F16
name: return_without_action
description: Tests a negative value and returns in both branches, so it does nothing.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:3:0F3C
name: blit_rows_into_work_buffer
description: Owns the blitter, sets the control and modulo registers, then starts one blit per row from two tables, with the row stride taken from the input. It releases the blitter when done.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:3:0FA4
name: blit_rows_work_buffer_swapped
description: Performs the same blitter row copy as its neighbour, with the two source tables and the stride roles reversed.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:3:100E
name: wait_until_flag_cleared
description: Repeatedly calls a routine while a global flag is nonzero, then calls one more routine and returns.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:3:102E
name: call_pair_if_zero
description: Calls one routine and, when it returns zero, calls two more routines.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:3:1050
name: release_slot_records_and_buffers
description: Clears a counter, fills position fields for each record in a slot table from an input record, then walks a second table of pointers and releases each non-null entry through the system memory-free call.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:3:10E2
name: advance_animation_entries
description: Walks fifteen pointer records. For each active record it counts down a delay and, when the delay expires, steps the frame index forward or back according to its mode flags, calling routines on each change.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:3:118E
name: retire_finished_entry_handler
description: When a record has its flag bit set and its counter reaches zero, it clears the active bit. Unless its type byte is the letter u, it also clears the stored function pointer.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:3:12F4
name: configure_entry_frame_fields
description: Fills in a record's frame, flag, timing and position fields from its inputs, looking up frame bytes from a table scaled by two or four when a flag bit is set. It returns minus one when the record is already busy.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:3:1378
name: step_strip_pattern_by_code
description: Selects one of several row-repeat patterns from a character code in a global, then calls routines while stepping a counter by 240 until it reaches a limit. It finishes with a fixed second pass.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:3:13F8
name: loop_step_until_limit
description: Calls a routine repeatedly while a counter stepped down by 240 stays above 1800. It sits in a gap between routines and may be an unreached fragment.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:3:14A8
name: blit_four_rows_with_offsets
description: Owns the blitter, sets its registers and starts four row blits with source and destination offsets read from two tables, using a fixed blit size and releasing the blitter at the end. If a flag is set it enters an endless wait loop.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:3:1500
name: blit_four_rows_fixed_height
description: Owns the blitter, sets its registers and starts four row blits with source and destination offsets from two tables, using a smaller fixed height than its neighbour. It releases the blitter at the end, and enters an endless wait loop when a flag is set.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:3:1568
name: set_flag_around_routine_call
description: Stores 16 into a status byte, calls another routine, then stores 64 back into the same byte. The routine is entered through a handler pointer stored in data.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:0000
name: clamp_scaled_value_into_struct
description: Scales a global value by two factors from the structure, shifting right by seven bits after each multiply when that factor is below 128. It clamps the result to 64 and stores it in a byte of the structure.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:0038
name: select_free_record_for_level
description: Checks a current record and its partner, switching index with an exclusive-or of three, for one that is not marked busy and whose threshold byte does not exceed the input. It stores a flag bit through a pointer and returns the chosen record, or zero when none fits.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:011C
name: store_byte_masked_with_two
description: Masks the input byte with the value two and stores the result through a pointer.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:012A
name: return_without_action
description: Does nothing: the decompiled body is an immediate return with no other work.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:0166
name: compute_fixed_point_position
description: Computes a 32-bit fixed-point position from several record fields. It either subtracts a stored offset or walks a linked list of segments, subtracting 65536 for each one while the value stays above a threshold, then clamps the result and returns the current list pointer.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:0208
name: clamp_elapsed_and_store_result
description: When the difference between the input and a stored field exceeds a threshold, calls a routine and stores its result in a record field.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:0228
name: call_routine_if_nonzero
description: Calls one routine when the input value is nonzero, and does nothing otherwise.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:0258
name: return_without_action
description: Does nothing: the decompiled body is an immediate return with no other work.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:025C
name: advance_segment_state_machine
description: Advances a per-record state machine through states one to six. States read segment data from a linked list and compare accumulated elapsed time against stored thresholds, and one state calls a routine.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:0288
name: advance_segment_state_machine
description: Runs the same segment state machine as its neighbour, but without the elapsed-time update at its start.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:029A
name: advance_segment_state_machine
description: Advances a per-record state machine through its states. States read segment data from a linked list and compare accumulated elapsed time against stored thresholds, and some states call routines.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:02DC
name: start_segment_hold_and_publish
description: Enters the hold state and stores the level and time. When the flag bit is set it accumulates elapsed time and clears the flag at a limit, then publishes the channel's state fields, using a default of 1000 when the level is zero, and calls a library routine.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:02F0
name: advance_segment_level_ramp
description: Steps a segment through its level ramp. It clamps the accumulated level to the signed 16-bit range and decrements the step count, moving on to the next data word or entering the hold state when the count reaches zero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:030E
name: start_segment_level_ramp
description: Starts a level ramp by setting its counter and initial level, then updates the running level with the same clamp and step logic as its neighbours.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:0374
name: publish_segment_channel_state
description: Enters the hold state, optionally accumulates elapsed time and clears a flag at a limit, then publishes the channel's state fields with a default of 1000 when the level is zero. It calls a library routine at the end.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:0380
name: publish_segment_from_pointer
description: Sets the segment data pointer and initial level from an input word, then applies the same hold timing and channel publication as its neighbours and calls a library routine.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:03AA
name: clamp_level_then_publish_channel
description: Updates the running level with a clamp to the signed 16-bit range, subtracts elapsed time, runs the hold timing check, then publishes the channel's state fields.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:03C4
name: reset_level_then_publish_channel
description: Resets the level to zero, subtracts elapsed time, runs the hold timing check, then publishes the channel's state fields.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:03FC
name: publish_channel_state_from_segment
description: Publishes the channel's state fields from the segment, with a default of 1000 when the level is zero, and calls a library routine when the hold bit is set.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:043E
name: store_words_then_call_table
description: Stores the default value 1000 and a zero word into a structure, then calls a library routine from a table in data.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:0454
name: clear_flag_bit_all_records
description: Calls one routine four times, then clears the top bit of a flag byte in each of sixteen 20-byte records and in one global flag.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:0492
name: store_pow2_mask_and_flag
description: Stores a power-of-two mask derived from the input into a structure and sets a flag byte, then calls a library routine. When a level field is below 37 it also writes a constant to a chip register.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:04D6
name: release_record_and_clear_mask
description: Releases a record by decrementing its counter field and a global count unless its state byte is sixteen. It clears the record's identifier and state fields, sets a mask bit, calls a library routine and conditionally writes a constant to a chip register.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:050A
name: init_struct_and_toggle_flag
description: Initialises several structure fields to fixed values (500, 8192, zero, 24 and 128), then sets or clears bits in a flag byte according to a source bit and clears two further bits.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:0550
name: dispatch_channel_command
description: Reads a command byte and applies it to a channel record. Depending on the code it sets a level from the argument, sets mask bits, caps a volume value at 24, updates flag bits, or updates a table of records.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:0568
name: dispatch_channel_command_reg
description: Applies a channel command whose code is in a register, reading the argument from the input record. It handles the same command codes as its neighbour.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:0582
name: apply_channel_volume_command
description: Handles a subset of channel command codes: a volume value capped at 24, a gain value, a flag bit toggle and a table-wide flag update.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:05C6
name: apply_channel_flag_command
description: Handles a smaller set of channel commands: a gain value, a flag bit toggle, a table-wide flag update and a bit clear that sets a field to 255.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:05DC
name: apply_channel_control_command
description: Handles a further subset of channel command codes, updating flag bits and table entries and copying a value into a record field.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:0600
name: set_record_flag_bit_one
description: Sets bit one in the flag byte of the record passed in a register.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:060A
name: dispatch_channel_command_part_one
description: Handles the later channel command codes: clears a flag bit and updates table entries for one code, sets or clears flag bits and writes a value into a record field for others, and calls routines for the remainder.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:0622
name: clear_mask_bit_reset_states
description: Clears bit three of a record's flag byte. For each of four table records that match this one, it clears a flag bit and sets the state to three when that bit was set.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:064E
name: dispatch_channel_command_part_two
description: Handles a set of channel command codes that set or clear flag bits, write two record fields, update a table entry, or call routines.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:0666
name: clear_flag_bit_set_byte
description: Clears bit two of a record's flag byte and sets the byte at offset 17 of the next record to 255.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:0676
name: dispatch_channel_command_part_three
description: Handles a smaller set of channel command codes: record field writes, flag bit set and clear, and calls to routines.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:068C
name: return_after_single_call
description: Calls one routine and returns, with no other work.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:0698
name: dispatch_channel_command_part_four
description: Handles channel command codes that write record fields, set or clear a flag bit, and call routines.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:06A6
name: dispatch_channel_command_part_five
description: Handles a few channel command codes that write record fields, set or clear a flag bit and call routines.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:06B4
name: dispatch_channel_command_part_six
description: Handles channel command codes that set or clear one flag bit and call routines.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:06C0
name: dispatch_channel_command_part_seven
description: Handles the last channel command codes, which set or clear one flag bit or only call routines.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:06CC
name: dispatch_channel_command_part_eight
description: Handles the final channel command codes: sets bit one of a flag byte, clears it, or calls a routine.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:06DE
name: clear_flag_bit_or_call
description: Clears bit one of a record's flag byte for one command code, or calls a routine for another code.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:06F0
name: call_routine_for_command_x
description: Calls one routine only when the command code is the letter x; otherwise it does nothing.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:06FC
name: assemble_value_and_scale_diff
description: Builds a 16-bit value from two input bytes and stores it in a record. It stores a scaled difference from 8192 in the next word, using a stored byte as the scale, and sets the top bit of a flag byte.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:0728
name: negate_result_if_signs_differ
description: Calls a routine and negates its result when the two input values have different signs, returning the signed result.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:074E
name: return_second_register_after_call
description: Calls one routine and returns the value left in a data register. It sits in a gap between routines and may be unreached.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:0758
name: return_after_single_call
description: Calls one routine and returns, with no other work.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:0760
name: perform_32bit_division
description: Divides a 32-bit value by a 32-bit divisor. It uses a 16-step shift-and-subtract loop when the divisor exceeds 16 bits and a direct divide otherwise, returning quotient and remainder in one 64-bit result.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:07D4
name: interpolate_table_and_shift
description: Looks up two adjacent 16-bit table values selected by the high byte of the input, interpolates between them with the low byte, then shifts the result by a count derived from the input and rounds it.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:0A26
name: allocate_state_and_install_interrupt
description: On first use, allocates a state block, sets its sub-buffer pointers and default values, then installs a handler with the system interrupt-server call. It returns one if the allocation fails.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:0B66
name: remove_interrupt_and_free_state
description: Calls two routines, removes the installed interrupt server if one is active, and releases the state block through the system memory-free call. It returns the free status.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:0BCE
name: open_audio_init_channels
description: On first use, sets up sixteen channel records and a 64-entry table, then opens the audio device and copies request data with the system copy routine. The referenced text names the audio device.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:0D48
name: close_audio_clear_channels
description: Clears the active flags and releases four channel records, then closes the audio device and marks it as closed.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:0DB6
name: trigger_channel_record_if_active
description: Checks that a channel record has a source and its enable flag is set, locates its slot, and when the slot's state allows, sets the channel's start flag and copies a saved byte. Otherwise it returns without change.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:0E50
name: initialise_channel_slot
description: Takes a free channel slot, records its pointers, source byte and mode, then sets its volume from a default of 128 scaled by a stored gain. It also resets the position and timing fields.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:0E7C
name: initialise_channel_and_reply_message
description: Initialises a channel slot and its volume, using a default of 1000 when unset. It then handles audio device messages by getting one and replying to it.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:0F50
name: process_audio_channel_messages
description: Processes a channel record against audio device messages. It increments a counter, updates a stored sample byte and the active flag, and when a reply is pending it gets and replies to messages before continuing.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:1046
name: clear_channel_record_fields
description: Zeroes a channel record's first word, its state and flag bytes, and a second counter.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:105A
name: match_channel_pattern_and_flag
description: Compares an input byte with a stored pattern byte for the channel in the global table. On a match it sets the channel's state to three, or sets a flag bit for records with the flag set.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:1094
name: match_channel_key_set_state
description: Compares the input byte with a key byte at offset 44 of the record. On a match it sets the state to three, or sets bit two of a flag byte when the record's flag bit eight is set.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:10AA
name: set_flag_bit_two
description: Sets bit two of the flag byte at offset 50 of the record passed in a register.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:10B4
name: update_matching_channel_states
description: When the record's first byte is set, it checks the four table records. For each one matching the given record it sets the state to three, or sets bit two of the flag byte when bit eight of the record's flag is set.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:10D6
name: update_matching_states_from_index
description: Walks the channel table from an index in a register. For each matching record it sets the state to three or sets a flag bit, and stops when the count runs out.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:10E6
name: run_routine_for_matching_channels
description: When the record's first byte is set, calls a routine for each of the four table records that match it.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:1112
name: reset_all_channel_records
description: Calls a routine for each nonempty entry in the four-slot table, then for each of sixteen 20-byte channel records calls a routine, clears bit one of its flag byte and sets a status byte to 255.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:1158
name: store_table_entry_pointer
description: Stores into the pointer register the address of a 22-byte entry in a global table, selected by the low six bits of the input byte.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:1174
name: store_word_and_call_routine
description: Stores the input word in a global, calls a routine and stores its result in a second global.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:11C4
name: update_port_button_flag
description: Calls a routine that reads the controller port register and sets bit one of a global flag when the returned word is zero, otherwise clears it. The port register holds joystick fire buttons and disk status.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:11E0
name: check_global_flag_bit
description: Returns one when bit one of a global flag is clear and zero when it is set. Its neighbour reads a controller port register that sets this bit.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:11F4
name: update_channel_timers_per_tick
description: When a pending flag is set it marks each active channel record for update. It then adds an elapsed value to a timing counter and walks the channel table, advancing the active records and writing their output values.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:12A4
name: advance_sequence_event_pointers
description: Walks four channel records and their six-byte sequence entries, decrementing each entry's countdown and advancing its pointer when the countdown reaches zero or passes its time. It calls routines for the events it reaches and records the current index.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:1370
name: process_sequence_command_byte
description: Interprets a sequence command byte: a minus-128 code loads a channel's timing pair from the next entry and resets its accumulator, while a minus-one code restarts the sequence or ends the channel depending on a flag. Other codes continue to the next step.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:1396
name: advance_sequence_with_timing
description: Loads the timing fields for the next sequence step, advances the step pointer and, when the elapsed counter allows, dispatches the event byte through a routine. It sets the channel's active bit.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:13C0
name: dispatch_sequence_end_action
description: Handles a sequence end: when the channel's loop flag is set it restarts from the saved start pointer, otherwise it stops the channel. It then updates the sequence pointer and accumulated time.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:13E0
name: stop_channel_playback
description: Stops a channel: clears its playing flag, stores the current pointer and accumulates remaining time. It sets or clears the channel's active bit depending on whether any of the four table records is still in use.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:13EA
name: dispatch_sequence_event_codes
description: Decodes sequence event bytes. Codes minus 32, minus 80 and minus 64 call routines, and minus 96 chooses a sub-action from the next byte: send a signal, push a return pointer onto a four-level stack, or pop from it.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:1424
name: dispatch_sequence_event_part_two
description: Handles the same event codes as its neighbour for minus 80, minus 64 and minus 96, calling routines and dispatching the sub-action for the last code.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:1452
name: dispatch_sequence_event_part_three
description: Handles the minus 64 event code by calling a routine, and the minus 96 sub-action for the sub-codes that signal or stack pointers.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:147A
name: dispatch_sub_command_stack_signal
description: Handles the minus 96 sub-command: sends a signal when the first sub-code is set, pushes a pointer onto a four-level stack for the second, and pops for the third.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a3]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a3].adf:ds:8:14B0
name: push_pop_sequence_stack
description: Pushes the current sequence pointer onto a four-level stack for sub-code two, or pops the most recent pointer and returns to it for sub-code three.
